title: Career Roadmap: Data Analyst
summary: Transform raw data into meaningful insights by cleaning datasets, identifying trends, building dashboards and preparing reports that help organizations make informed business and operational decisions.

blocks.text: Transform raw data into meaningful insights by cleaning datasets, identifying trends, building dashboards and preparing reports that help organizations make informed business and operational decisions.

rows.text: Mathematics and Computer Science are useful; eligibility depends on the programme
BS in Computer Science & Data Analysis, B.Sc. Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or Computer Science
Business intelligence, financial analytics, product analytics, marketing analytics or operations analytics
M.Sc. Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics or an MBA in Business Analytics, where useful

blocks.text: Verify the programme's admission requirements and ensure it provides a foundation in programming, statistics, databases and analytical methods.

blocks.label: SQL
blocks.text: Joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs and window functions.

blocks.label: Excel
blocks.text: Pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas and data cleaning.

blocks.label: Programming
blocks.text: Python, pandas, NumPy and basic data visualisation.

blocks.label: BI Tools
blocks.text: Power BI or Tableau for interactive dashboards.

blocks.label: Statistics
blocks.text: Descriptive statistics, distributions, correlation and hypothesis testing.

blocks.label: Business Communication
blocks.text: KPI interpretation, report writing and presenting actionable insights.
Build three to four practical projects:

blocks.label: Sales Analysis
blocks.text: Identify revenue trends, top-performing products and regional differences.

blocks.label: Customer Analytics
blocks.text: Examine retention, customer segmentation and churn.

blocks.label: Interactive Dashboard
blocks.text: Develop a Power BI or Tableau dashboard with meaningful KPIs.

blocks.label: Public Dataset Analysis
blocks.text: Clean and analyse a dataset, then present evidence-based recommendations.
For each project, document the business question, data-cleaning process, analysis, visualisations and conclusions.
Target opportunities at:
Search for roles such as Data Analyst Intern, Business Intelligence Intern, Reporting Analyst Intern and Business Analyst Intern.
Prioritize:

items.text: Cloud data fundamentals, such as AWS or Azure.

blocks.text: Combine certificates with practical projects to demonstrate job-ready skills.
Data Analytics Intern
Junior Data Analyst
Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst
Senior Data Analyst → Analytics Lead / Manager
With additional skills in experimentation, statistical modelling and machine learning, analysts may transition into product analytics or data science.

rows.text: Learn Excel, SQL fundamentals, descriptive statistics and data cleaning.
Practise advanced SQL, analyse data using Python and create an interactive dashboard.
Complete two portfolio projects, prepare for analytical interviews and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong SQL and Excel skills, working knowledge of Python, statistical reasoning, dashboard development and two to four documented projects demonstrating real analytical problem-solving.
